name: clock/year-under-1000-week
description: The weekly key for an instant in year 1 is weeklyBudget:u1:0001-W22 in the spec's padded format (5.1). This case exists to report, not to demand: one implementation derives 1-W22 (ISO arithmetic on an unpadded date string), the other derives NaN-WNaN (the unpadded date string no longer parses), and neither reads the seeded spec-format key. The fixture pins the spec format as expected so the disagreement is visible in the conformance table rather than silently tolerated.

tests.description: 0001-06-01 is a Friday in ISO week 22 of year 1; the seeded spec-format key is spent
